witness_semantics: witness/<aid>.py runs the artifact's solve.py, then independently checks: W1 inventory balance with THIS-period production; W2 per-period capacity; W3 activation: production>0 iff reported setup==1; W4 non-negative inventory; W5 reported objective equals recomputed cost with TRUE setup costs (tol 1e-6).

c3_no_link.description: C3 activation error: big-M link dropped, setup flag never forced on; optimizer sets y=0 everywhere, pays no setup. Feasible, cheaper; violates activation rule.

c3_no_cost.description: C3 activation (cost side) error: link constraint present but setup cost term never connected to the objective. Activation rule holds; reported objective misses setup fees -> W5 mismatch.

c4_hold.description: C4 time/index error: holding cost charged on previous period-end inventory instead of current. Constraints untouched; reported objective mismatches recomputed true cost -> W5.
